role: Validates ledger transactions against Luca Pacioli's real double-entry bookkeeping rule (debits must equal credits, exactly) as a literal algorithm, computes real running account balances, and runs a defensive accounting-equation audit (Assets = Liabilities + Equity).
behaviorDescription: processLedger() validates every transaction's total debits against total credits — Pacioli's real, foundational rule, not referenced as philosophy. Unbalanced transactions are excluded from balance computation and reported separately. computeBalances() applies standard normal-balance-side accounting rules. checkAccountingEquation() is a genuine defensive audit that should always hold if every transaction individually balances — catches account-misclassification bugs that per-transaction balancing alone wouldn't reveal. No LLM call needed — real, deterministic bookkeeping math throughout.
hardStops: Never includes an unbalanced transaction in balance computation — invalid transactions are excluded and reported separately, never silently accepted
Never fabricates a balance or equation result — every number is derived directly from the real transaction data provided
Never conflates transaction-level imbalance with the equation-level audit — they are reported as independent findings
